route_results.reason: Land acquisition, parcel rights and compensation are frozen by Campaign185; project claims, completion and remediation are frozen by Campaign200; consultation, accommodation and benefit-sharing obligations are frozen by Campaign280. Selecting compulsory acquisition, an affected-person class, a compensation component, jurisdiction or resettlement stage would combine or subset terminal mechanisms.

AEO certification is a statutory operating qualification, inspection and suspension lifecycle combined with customs compliance and certificate states already frozen by Campaign179, Campaign180, Campaign221 and Campaign222. Tier, customs region, mutual-recognition partner or lifecycle stage cannot create economic independence.

Facility designation and requisition are statutory operating-right states, mobilization is an operating milestone or asset-readiness state, and suspension, demobilization and restoration are incident or asset-recovery states. Emergency authority, facility type or activation stage is a cohort and lifecycle combination.

Towage and vessel-call execution are explicit Campaign222 states, vessel availability and repair are Campaign186 states, casualty and restoration are Campaign166 states, and award, mobilization, claim, completion and release are Campaign200 project states. Vessel, wreck, authority, role or stage selection is a subtype rescue.

Campaign273 and Campaign276 already close public procurement, tender and award variants against supply-chain, major-contract and construction lifecycles. Debarment, qualification, protest, review and reinstatement add generic enforcement or statutory-right stages rather than a new economic primitive. Portal, buyer level, jurisdiction or event stage cannot reopen the route.

Monitoring, warning and remediation are environmental operating states; evacuation and closure are operational incidents; stabilization and clearance are asset or project recovery. Hazard class, site, warning threshold, affected facility or remediation stage is a cohort, parameter or lifecycle combination.

Spectrum and frequency rights are explicit Campaign179 states, interconnection and service-quality impairment, repair and restoration are explicit Campaign205 states, and discrete outages are Campaign166 incidents. Band, technology, geography, interference cause or remediation stage is an exact source or cohort rescue.

decision.reason: Every frozen route is already covered by immutable terminal land, project, community-obligation, license, customs, certification, incident, asset, maritime, procurement, enforcement, environmental or telecommunications primitives. The frozen priority rule therefore stops Campaign281 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign282 may freeze a new genuinely independent finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign281 or earlier route with a current snapshot, incomplete coverage, sibling source, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold or direction.
